title: Which Elemental Creature Is Your Companion?
description: Somewhere out there, a tiny elemental spirit shares your exact personality. Time to meet yours!

questions.text: How do you start a big new project?

answers.text: All in, day one, full intensity
Ease in and let it take shape naturally
Start five parts at once and see what sticks
Daydream about it until the vision is perfect

questions.text: Your reaction to sudden plan changes:

answers.text: Frustrating — you had momentum going
Honestly? You barely notice
Fine, as long as someone updates the calendar
New plans are just bonus adventures
No plans. See where the day goes.
Finally finishing that shelf project, then a good dinner
Three activities before noon
An art museum, then sketching in a café

questions.text: What annoys you — just a little?

answers.text: Slow walkers when you're on a mission
People who don't RSVP
Long meetings that could've been a text
Being interrupted mid-daydream

questions.text: Your friends rely on you for:

answers.text: The push to actually go for it
Keeping the peace when tensions rise
Being exactly where you said you'd be
Seeing the magic in ordinary days
A hard workout that empties the tank
A long bath and zero obligations
A power nap — twenty minutes, good as new
Getting completely lost in a story
Conviction. You believe it fully, and it shows
Somehow it stops being an argument and becomes a chat
Receipts. You remember exactly what was said
A joke so good the argument ends itself

questions.text: How do you win an argument?

answers.text: Music — it made time disappear
History — everything making sense in order
Science — especially the experiments
Art. Obviously.

questions.text: Pick a school subject you secretly loved:

answers.text: Short. Direct. Sent before you finished thinking
Full sentences, proper punctuation, reasonable hours
Seventeen rapid-fire messages that are one thought
Voice memos and the occasional poem

questions.text: A perfect gift for you would be:

answers.text: Tickets to something with a countdown clock
A hammock
Something practical you'll use for a decade
Something handmade, clearly chosen with care
Head of operations — this WILL be perfect
Distraction duty. You're unsuspicious by nature
Decorations, done at improbable speed
Designing the theme down to the napkins

questions.text: Pick your role in a surprise party plot:

answers.text: 'Your energy is contagious'
'You're so easy to be around'
'I knew I could count on you'
'I can't keep up with you — in a good way'

questions.text: The best compliment you could receive:

results.description: Your companion is the Emberling — a small flame spirit with your exact intensity. Like you, it's all-in on everything: passionate, driven, and impossible to ignore.
Your companion is the Glimmerwing — a shimmering dream-moth drawn to beauty and wonder. Like you, it sees magic in ordinary places and makes the whole world feel softer.
Your companion is the Ripplefin — a serene water sprite that flows around every obstacle. Like you, it stays calm in chaos and somehow makes everything feel easier.
Your companion is the Thornsprout — a sturdy little leaf guardian that never wavers. Like you, it's deeply rooted: dependable, protective, and built to last.
Your companion is the Zapkit — a crackling bundle of pure curiosity and speed. Like you, it's already three ideas ahead and having fun with all of them.
